candidates.title: Orangutans choose treats linked to laughter sounds
candidates.description: New research reveals that captive orangutans are more likely to select food associated with the sound of their peers laughing, suggesting emotions play a key role in animal learning.

candidates.title: Finnish puppy livestream becomes TV smash hit
candidates.description: A 24-hour webcam following newborn puppies and their mother has captivated millions of viewers, offering wholesome updates on the pups' growth and development.

candidates.title: Blue Planet III captures octopus escape from death
candidates.description: The latest David Attenborough series features a dramatic sequence where an octopus narrowly escapes after a hunt goes wrong, showcasing nature's resilience.

candidates.title: Scientists find potential way to save the banana
candidates.description: With climate change and disease threatening the Cavendish banana, researchers hope a breakthrough in breeding techniques could secure its future for consumers worldwide.

candidates.title: Retired decorator finds £1.5m Pokémon treasure
candidates.description: A man discovered a rare collection of Pokémon cards stored in his attic for 15 years, turning a forgotten hobby into a significant financial windfall.

candidates.title: Apple Watch Ultra 4 review: better battery life
candidates.description: Apple’s latest smartwatch delivers improved health tracking and significantly longer battery life, though it awaits more transformative AI features.

candidates.title: Matilda musical celebrates 15 years of success
candidates.description: The beloved stage adaptation continues to delight audiences globally, having been seen by over 12 million people since its debut in Stratford-upon-Avon.

candidates.title: Australia offers astronaut Katherine Bennell-Pegg for ISS mission
candidates.description: The Australian of the Year has been selected for a 2028 space mission to the International Space Station, potentially becoming the first Australian astronaut under the national flag.

candidates.title: Gen Z embraces Y2K cars over new SUVs
candidates.description: Young Americans are increasingly choosing affordable, fixable used cars from the early 2000s, defying expectations and prioritizing independence over new vehicle loans.

candidates.title: Tour de France 2027 routes reveal British stages
candidates.description: Organizers unveiled an ambitious start for next year's race, featuring six days of racing across Scotland, England, and Wales before heading to France.

candidates.title: Eleven-year-old chess prodigy eyes world record
candidates.description: Bodhana Sivanandan is poised to become the youngest female international master in history, breaking Judit Polgar’s long-standing age record.

candidates.title: Citizen scientists track global shoreline changes
candidates.description: An app called CoastSnap allows volunteers worldwide to use their camera phones to help researchers monitor coastal erosion and environmental changes effectively.

candidates.title: Grandmas take over TikTok with 15 million followers
candidates.description: Several grandmothers have found viral fame on social media, sharing their lives and wisdom with massive audiences and proving age is just a number online.
